hypotheses.name: State-bound semantic correction
hypotheses.concrete_failure: Two complete JSON outputs mix an explicitly rejected dict candidate with the current accepted object state and include an identical old/new edit.
hypotheses.candidate_change: Represent each feedback observation as snapshot digest, complete public test identity, acceptance status, and current-versus-historical scope. Require every proposed edit to cite a current source digest and specify a nonidentical source span. Bind validation errors to the individual edit without inventing or silently applying a patch. A parser variant may record and skip an identical old/new edit only after its allowed path and unique current-source span are verified; every nonidentical edit still undergoes the original validation, and an empty effective patch is not a successful repair.
hypotheses.established_now: Current prompts already contain labels and current source, yet the model still confuses them. In-memory reconstruction after discarding only the identical edit yields the same complete business source as an observed PASS run, for both responses.
hypotheses.unconfirmed: A complete revised parser deployment improves success across fresh paired runs, or a revised state presentation reduces confusion. No revised parser or new trajectory was executed.

hypotheses.name: Incumbent preservation with reversible exploration
hypotheses.concrete_opportunity: O-only accepted a real 2/3-to-1/3 candidate, then reached 3/3 by repairing consumers; SET found a direct path and did not need that regression on this issue.
hypotheses.candidate_change: Keep the accepted best source and all original public progress as the deliverable incumbent. An ordinary-passing but progress-losing candidate may be retained only as a separate labelled exploratory state. A later candidate is committed only after the original admission rule is satisfied. Count every branch generation and native evaluation within the same common resource allowance.
hypotheses.established_now: A temporary regression followed by repair is a real observed path, not a necessary path or a SET failure.
hypotheses.unconfirmed: Exploration rescues failures, extra branch machinery has a net benefit, or SET-specific identity protection improves terminal outcomes.

hypotheses.name: Provider-consumer contract validation
hypotheses.concrete_failure: A backend return-object-to-dict change breaks internal consumers accessing object attributes. One successful alternative repairs two consumers; seven preserve the original backend return object.
hypotheses.candidate_change: Connect proposed provider changes to current-source consumers and request explicit justification or coordinated edits for affected callers. Historical provider images must not be treated as the current interface. Public tests remain the acceptance authority.
hypotheses.established_now: Two AST-distinct terminal variants passed the original observed acceptance; current static relationship text did not prevent the initial regression.
hypotheses.unconfirmed: The proposed static check is complete, all callers are safe, or the relationship module independently increases recovery.
